title: Following calls through three functions
description: You can track an area value as it becomes a cylinder volume.

steps.description: circleArea returns the area computed from radius. You can reuse its returned number in another function.
cylinderVolume calls circleArea with its radius parameter. It multiplies the returned area by height.

steps.question: What volume does main receive for radius 10 and height 2?
steps.answer: It receives 628.318, the area 314.159 multiplied by 2.

steps.description: The final call starts main, which stores the volume in v. You see The cylinder holds 628.318 cubic units.
